text:
matt: Seeing intermittent imagePullBackOff on new GPU nodes in eu-west-1c and eu-west-1b. Kubelet logs show TCP RST to the iface ENI IPs (172.31.45.9). Anyone else seeing ECR pulls fail?

jess: yep. ECR access via the interface endpoint started flapping ~15m ago. Also saw ENI detach/reattach events for vpce-0123456789abcdef on nodes in 1b. pods stuck in ImagePullBackOff.

priya: quick check of the VPC endpoints: interface endpoint in eu-west-1b shows health checks toggling, route table assoc looks fine, but a couple of endpoints had EnablePrivateDnsName set to false (automation bug?). That would break DNS -> ECR private hostnames.

alex: ran: 
```
aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters "Name=description,Values=*vpce-*" --region eu-west-1
```
Output shows multiple ENIs for vpce-012345 in state "available" with no attachment for AZ b. Also saw recent API throttling errors in CloudTrail: "ThrottlingException: Rate exceeded".

infra-bot: ALERT: vpce-012345 health checks failing in eu-west-1b (5 consecutive failures). See console: https://console.aws.amazon.com/vpce/home?region=eu-west-1#/vpce/vpce-012345

matt: This is hitting our GPU fleet: kube-scheduler can't place GPU pods because nodes can't fetch images, so scale-up is effectively stalled — we lost ~6 GPU-minutes. If this persists we'll starve inference jobs.

jess: Temporary workaround is to route node subnet egress through NAT as fallback for image pulls, but that will increase cost and bypass our PrivateLink access controls. Not ideal. @sre-oncall any recommendations?

sre-oncall: don't open up 0.0.0.0/0 egress on endpoint SGs. Options: 1) temporarily add the ECR public IP ranges to the endpoint SG (ugly), 2) add a targeted route table override for the affected AZ to route 0.0.0.0/0 via the NAT for only node subnets, or 3) reduce the lambda/provisioner concurrency causing ENI creation throttles. I'm leaning to (3) + (2) as short term.

priya: root cause: our endpoint ENI creator lambda had a bug where it retried too aggressively and got API throttled, leaving ENIs in "available" state and failing to update the private DNS mapping for the endpoint in that AZ. Patch is ready to reduce concurrency and add jitter.

alex: reproduced locally: kubelet log snippet: 
```
Kubelet: Pulling image "123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/worker:latest"
HTTPStatusCode=0, Error: read tcp 10.0.5.23:60638->172.31.45.9:443: read: connection reset by peer
```

matt: patch merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/commit/abcd1234 - added exponential backoff and a safety throttle for ENI creation per-AZ. Also added better metrics to the lambda.

alex: plan to apply a route override for the affected node subnets in eu-west-1b to nat-gw-0aa1 as a rollback while lambda fix propagates. Will revert once endpoints stable.

deploy-bot: deploy:route-override-job started by matt @ 2026-03-18T15:21:05Z

jess: after route override, nodes in 1b started pulling images again and new gpu nodes joined cluster. Keeping monitors up for 30m. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: cost-alert: NAT bytes spiked +120% during fallback window (estimated $45 extra so far).

priya: follow-ups: (1) roll the lambda fix to prod, (2) add rate-limiter metrics to our infra dashboard, (3) add runbook step to check VPC endpoint EnablePrivateDnsName flag during incidents.

matt: thanks all — we recovered capacity. Will keep this thread updated if anything resurfaces.
